description: Header file defining the VideoContextWrapper class for managing D3D11 video decoding context on Windows, including buffer handling and interface methods.

classes.name: VideoContextWrapper
classes.description: Abstract class providing an interface for managing D3D11 video decoding context, including buffer management and frame control.

methods.name: CreateWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create a VideoContextWrapper instance based on supported D3D11 version and device context.

methods.name: DecoderBeginFrame
methods.description: Starts decoding a video frame with specified decoder and output view.

methods.name: GetDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a decoder buffer of a specified type.

methods.name: ReleaseDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Releases a decoder buffer of a specified type.

methods.name: DecoderEndFrame
methods.description: Ends decoding of the current frame.

methods.name: SubmitDecoderBuffers
methods.description: Submits an array of buffers for decoding.
